scope: Original-backed native semantics, inferred unit ownership and complete instruction equality. Does not itself grant matching acceptance.
compiler: MSVC 5.0 RTM /Gy /O2; no flag tuning; HERCULES_ENGINE3 selects native ENG3 layouts

ownership.transition: Existing original-backed actor_transition_01460.c supplies the complete 01460 body; 01600 is its adjacent extended contact/frame-offset variant before 01870. Inferred source ownership, not historical TU identity.
ownership.actor: 01880 is bracketed by existing actor_handlers.c 01870 and 01890, with the same conditional level-8 tail-dispatch idiom.
ownership.high: 27370 follows handlers_26b40.c 272e0 initializer and matches its sidecar/state/RNG/spawn idioms; the next unit begins at 279a0.
ownership.level: Shared level_frame_01e50.c 7840/7e00 bracket 7d10 and 8000 precedes 8050. ENG3 retains word scroll coordinates versus ENG1 byte coordinates; 82d0 resets this four-byte scroll record.
ownership.reserved_title: 8340 and 84b0 are native variants of u02b70.c 048a0/04a10, with 10 rather than 18 slots. Their unified diff and 416-byte instruction-equal receipt are delivered separately for the owner; excluded from integration.

semantics.27370: Native call/RNG order preserved in four effect constructions, four actor constructions, and twelve fragments. Each child is reloaded and conditional facing/render stores remain in native order. No simplified case arithmetic.
semantics.transition: Three original signed-long motion fields are halved arithmetically. Moving only independent velocity/acceleration stores reproduces scheduling. No call or external-state read is reordered.
semantics.7d10: Native frame ordering-table offset is 0x2080 and clamped depth byte offset is 0x1ff4; ENG1 retains 0x1384/0x12f8.
semantics.82d0: Native allocates signed_count*4 and clears two word components through reloaded pointer cells.
